'''Tom Thigpen Bothan Regenerator''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site]] as '''Bothan Regenerator'''. [[Tom Thigpen]] posted it in 1999.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Tom Thigpen]]
* '''Published:''' 1999 (Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star: Docking Bay 327|Premiere-L-deathstardockingbay327.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Bothan Regenerator
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PSE DSDB Thigpen LS 1999 Red32.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

The lift tubes are in their for their destiny 6's and to move the bothan spies around a lot quicker. The game takes a while, considering all you do is Force drain with Luke Skywalker, Obi-Wan's Lightsaber at the hut, and Princess Organa at the war room holding a jedi lightsaber. Use the bothan spies/undercovers to block all their drains. Keep playing Death Star plans on an undercover Bothan Spy. This way they cant fight him, and he can keep retrieving tons of Force for you. Total drain for you (counting the docking bays and the trash compactor) = 6. With Luke and Obi at his hut and their lightsabers (2), the Princess at the war room with a Jedi Lightsaber (1), Yavin 4 Docking Bay (1), Death Star Docking Bay (1), Trash Compactor (1), not much of a total Force drain potential, but theirs will be none, unless they play space.. Then you can always add a few X-Wings/Landing Claws, in case, and pack a few senses in case of "Shut Him Up or Shut Him Down", (it cancels Death Star Plans). So you have to watch out for that. It will probably be hard for most people to get that many Bothan Spies, Undercovers and Death Star Plans, but it's not a deck to go to a tournament with anyway. Other things to watch out for is Secret Plans and Come Here You Big Coward. Chances are you'll never get to regenerate enough because these two cards will hinder your progress.
